It’s not necessarily from centralized exchanges, it’s payments so in can be from anywhere This operator doesn’t hundreds of million in volume and this pattern kept increasing in the last months Also it’s not only payments there are a bunch of other patterns if you see the smart contract flows All the usages should be included in the analysis including volume some other correction: (0x6dd1ad99…) is a verified Coinsbuy-template Factory funded from 0xC6Ac… Coinsbuy not a phishing The other three are shuffling funds, plausible phishing, not confimed the 4th is def the most important as has multiple users including Union Chain, SwapKit (infra), Vultisig, Rain (Neobank), payment processing, neobank topups and bridging just a few of the current usage can you correct/highlight this? It's def the most important Also, we should probably look at other chain too as this pattern is very tied to cost, e.g. BNB has as much ephimeral contracts dailiy activity as ethereum, Tron even more Also adding the volume would be good to, the forth operator does approx 100M per month (and started in July) also 0x8bcee326 unlabelled is OrderForwarderFactory - another merchant checkout flow
